description: Convert MD to target format. Images (from OPP images.json) are extracted during conversion into images.zip + images.json alongside the output document when separate_images=True (default). When separate_images=False, images embedded as base64 data URIs in the markdown are decoded and placed inline in the output document by Pandoc.

output_path.description: Optional output path. Must be inside an allowed directory.

reference_doc.description: Pandoc reference DOCX for style template.

target_format.description: Target format (docx, odt, epub, html, rtf, pdf, pptx, icml, srt, csv, xlsx, xml, ipynb, eml, msg, json).

traceparent.description: Optional W3C Trace Context traceparent header to make this ORF span a child of an upstream trace (e.g. from OL translate_md_text).

name: apply_md

description: Apply XLIFF translation to original document with optional image injection. Provide either xliff_path or xliff_content (mutually exclusive). Image placements must use data_base64 — file_path is rejected (C4 fix).

force.description: Bypass skeleton-vs-format validation for cross-format conversions.

format.description: Output format (docx, pptx, epub, html, odf, ...).

input_file.description: Path to source document (DOCX, PPTX, EPUB, ...).

output_path.description: Path to write the backfilled document.

traceparent.description: Optional W3C Trace Context traceparent header to make this ORF span a child of an upstream trace (e.g. from OL translate_xliff).

xliff_content.description: XLIFF body as a string (mutually exclusive with xliff_path).

name: apply_xliff

description: Batch convert MD files in a directory to a target format.

input_dir.description: Directory containing MD files to convert.

name: batch_convert

description: Detect document format using magic bytes detection.
name: detect_format

description: Get document information (format, size, resource count, manifest status).
name: info

description: Health check endpoint. Returns module name and version.
name: ping
